name: Traveler (Cryo)
notes: The newest Traveler: KQM has no guide for it, so the card rests on Game8 (Stellar Glimmer DPS build) and genshin-builds.com (checked 2026-10-30). They agree on 4pc Disenchantment in Deep Shadow, Heart of the Furnace as a lower option, ATK% Sands and Goblet, a CRIT Circlet, Exaiphanes Blade first, and the goals (ATK 2,400, ER 125-145, CR 70, CD 140 or above; Game8 adds EM 150-200). genshin-builds' goals read like Game8's, so they are one voice, not two. Set options differ at the margin (Game8 adds Tenacity of the Millelith; genshin-builds adds Scarlet Proof). Talent order differs: Game8 is Burst > Normal Attack > Skill for Stellar-Swirl (Normal Attack > Burst > Skill for Stellar-Conduct); genshin-builds is Skill > Burst > Normal Attack. The Burst's Ice Javelin is the damage (55.1% to 99.2% per strike, elemental curve), so Game8's Stellar-Swirl order is used. Goals use the upper ends. Partners are inferred from the Stellar-Conduct set's Electro trigger.
